definitions.explanation: Leave taken from work to care for a young child, available to both mothers and fathers under Japanese law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{育児休暇|いくじきゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: My husband decided to take parental leave too.

examples.japanese: {育児休暇|いくじきゅうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最長|さいちょう}→最長：13076_saichou⟧1⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}できる→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Parental leave can be taken for up to one year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{育児休暇|いくじきゅうか}{取得率|しゅとくりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The rate of men taking parental leave is increasing.

examples.japanese: {育児休暇|いくじきゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}りたい→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧にくい。
examples.english: I want to take parental leave, but the workplace atmosphere makes it hard to speak up.

examples.japanese: {育児休暇|いくじきゅうか}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}した→復帰する：25395_fukkisuru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{時短勤務|じたんきんむ}→時短勤務：18090_jitankinmu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えた→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧。
examples.english: After returning from parental leave, I switched to reduced working hours.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧ (childcare) + ⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧ (leave, vacation).

LEGAL NAME: ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧・{介護休業法|かいごきゅうぎょうほう} (Childcare and Caregiver Leave Act) officially calls it ⟦{育児休業|いくじきゅうぎょう}→育児休業：25440_ikujikyuugyou⟧.

ABBREVIATION: ⟦{育休|いくきゅう}→育休：08565_ikukyuu⟧ (colloquial).

JAPAN'S SYSTEM:
- Available until child is 1 year old (extendable to 2 years in some cases)
- Both parents can take leave
- Partial wage replacement through employment insurance
- Job protection during leave period

RELATED LEAVE TYPES:
- ⟦{産休|さんきゅう}→産休：06997_sankyuu⟧: maternity leave (before/after birth)
- {産前休暇|さんぜんきゅうか}: prenatal leave
- {産後休暇|さんごきゅうか}: postnatal leave
- ⟦{介護休暇|かいごきゅうか}→介護休暇：08566_kaigokyuuka⟧: family care leave

CURRENT TRENDS:
- Government promoting "⟦イクメン→イクメン：06723_ikumen⟧" (hands-on fathers)
- Increasing male participation in childcare
- Corporate culture slowly changing
